'''Incomplete article.''' The Japanese card face is shown. Fields awaiting verification are marked below.

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ウーティーニー！</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-118o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：自分のジャワの１人がウーティーニー・エフェクトと同じ場所にいるなら、そのカードを“盗んで”自分の手札にいれることができる。後は、自分のカードとして使用できる。２：カードの名前に“ジャワ”が含まれるインタラプトかエフェクトを１つ打ち消すことができる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ジャワ同士の言葉で、「こっちへ来い！」の意。ジャワは共同で働き、機械装備をあさる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Utinni!

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. If one of your Jawas is at the same location as an Utinni Effect, you may steal that card into your hand. You may then use it as your own. 2. You may cancel one Interrupt or Effect with Jawa in its title.

'''Lore:''' In Jawaese it means “Come here!” Jawas work together and scavenge for machinery.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4
* '''Printed subtype:''' Used Interrupt

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
